name: plan-review-verdict
body: The plan-review agent's verdict on a plan against the change-set delta, in two passes. (a) A DETERMINISTIC coverage verdict read from the binary's `apg plan verify` refusal at plan-review time: the `domain.entity.plan-coverage` rule decides which solution nodes' `implemented-by` claims are in scope, and ONLY the per-FQN entries under the refusal's `coverage incomplete:` clause are blocking gaps, each attached to the owning phase/task; the `no implemented-by edge` (no-claims) list in that same clause is reported but is NOT a gap, and the absence of a `coverage incomplete:` clause means coverage holds. The expected unrealized-planned-node and unresolved-feedback blockers — and a stale branch graph, which makes verify bail before any verdict — are NOT coverage gaps; the agent ensures the branch scan is fresh first, then reproduces the binary's coverage verdict rather than recomputing coverage by inspection. (b) A SEMANTIC verdict on each plan node: whether it does the right thing for the delta, biased toward less code — `deletes` over `modifies`, `modifies` over `creates`, fewer planned nodes — where removing a solution node or an `implemented-by` edge almost always calls for a `deletes` task over the code it pointed at, and any keep/modify instead of that delete must carry a task-note justification.
